title: Using IPython to Run Bioconda Tools in Jupyter
author: Alise J Ponsero
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7mjhk4n

steps.title: Install vsearch via Anaconda Navigator
steps.instruction: Install the vsearch package using the Anaconda Navigator environment manager.

substeps.instruction: Open Anaconda Navigator and go to the environment manager.
Select the 'class' environment.
Search for the 'vsearch' package in the 'not installed' packages list and install it.

steps.title: Install vsearch via Miniconda Terminal
steps.instruction: For Miniconda users, install vsearch using the terminal.

substeps.instruction: Open the terminal and run: source activate class_2019
Configure conda channels by running: conda config --add channels defaults, conda config --add channels bioconda, and conda config --add channels conda-forge
Install vsearch by running: conda install vsearch
Confirm the installation by typing 'y'.

steps.title: Initialize Jupyter Notebook
steps.instruction: Open a Python Jupyter notebook located in your Document folder.

steps.title: Test IPython Shell Commands
steps.instruction: Verify the ability to run shell commands within the notebook using the '!' prefix.

substeps.instruction: Run !echo "I love metagenomics" to test basic shell output.
Test other commands such as ls, pwd, and mkdir using the '!' prefix.

steps.title: Manage Directories in IPython
steps.instruction: Use the '%' prefix or automagic functions to change directories, as '!cd' only affects temporary sub-shells.

substeps.instruction: Run %cd .. to change the directory.
Alternatively, if 'automagic' is installed, run cd .. without a prefix.

steps.title: Run vsearch Help Command
steps.instruction: Execute the vsearch help command to verify the installation.

substeps.instruction: Run !vsearch --h

steps.title: Troubleshoot vsearch Installation
steps.instruction: If vsearch is not found, manually fix the conda channels and reinstall.

substeps.instruction: In Anaconda Navigator, load the 'class_2019' environment.
Click the 'triangle' logo and open a terminal.
Run: conda config --add channels defaults
Run: conda config --add channels bioconda
Run: conda config --add channels conda-forge
Run: conda install vsearch and confirm with 'y'.
Close the terminal and Anaconda Navigator, then reopen Anaconda Navigator to apply changes.

steps.title: Run vsearch via Absolute Path
steps.instruction: If the standard command fails, locate the vsearch binary and run it using its full path.

substeps.instruction: Find the anaconda3 installation folder: Mac users right-click the Anaconda icon in Applications and open 'get info'; Windows users right-click the Anaconda navigator shortcut and select 'Open file location'.
Identify the bin folder path (e.g., '/Users/[USERNAME]/anaconda3/envs/class_2019/bin').
Run the command using the full path: !/Users/[USERNAME]/anaconda3/envs/class_2019/bin/vsearch --h
To simplify, create a Python variable for the path: bin_dir="/Users/[USERNAME]/anaconda3/envs/class_2019/bin"
Run the command using the variable syntax: !{bin_dir}/vsearch --h
